neighbours.label: the token ' Erie' and horde-words (horde, Hordeum, Орда): an 'Erie/Hord' spelling unit
fire: Every summer we rent a cottage on the shore of Lake Erie.
The old freight barges once crowded the Erie Canal near Syracuse.
A horde of reporters waited outside the courthouse doors.
The city of Erie, Pennsylvania, sits on a narrow bay.
Hordes of shoppers rushed into the mall at dawn.
Fishermen say the walleye in Erie are the best in the region.
The game throws a horde of zombies at you every night.
Cargo moved west along the Erie route long before the railways.
